drums.tags: Solo acoustic guitar fingerstyle performance. The arrangement features a constant alternating thumb bass pattern on the lower strings while the index and middle fingers play syncopated melody lines and chordal fragments on the higher strings. The guitar has a bright, steel-string timbre with prominent fret noise and percussive string slaps. The performance utilizes open tunings with frequent use of hammer-ons, pull-offs, and slides to connect melodic phrases. The tempo is 115 BPM in 4/4 time. The recording has a close-mic proximity effect with minimal room reverb.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[bright steel-string acoustic guitar enters with alternating thumb bass]

[Section A]
[syncopated melody over steady quarter-note bass notes]
[percussive string slaps on beats 2 and 4]

[Section B]
[ascending melodic runs using hammer-ons and pull-offs]
[sustained open string drones]

[Outro]
[ritardando]
[final strummed open chord with natural resonance]

vocals.tags: Bossa nova and Latin jazz. Nylon string acoustic guitar plays syncopated fingerstyle chords with a steady thumb-plucked bassline. A flute performs melodic improvisations using trills, flutter-tonguing, and rapid scalar runs. Percussion consists of a shaker playing consistent sixteenth notes and a woodblock or rimshot hitting on the fourth beat of every second measure. The tempo is 124 BPM in 4/4 time. The key is G major. The arrangement maintains a sparse, acoustic texture with a dry mix and minimal artificial reverb.
vocals.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[nylon string acoustic guitar, syncopated fingerstyle pattern]
[shaker enters with sixteenth notes]

[Main Theme]
[flute enters with legato melody]
[woodblock accents on beat 4 of alternating measures]

[Flute Solo]
[flute performs rapid trills and chromatic runs]
[acoustic guitar continues rhythmic comping]

[Outro]
[flute melody slows]
[shaker fades out]
[final sustained acoustic guitar chord]
